Commons describes this file as «Епископ Фаддей. 1910-е годы», bishop Thaddaeus in the 1910s, and the category is the new-martyr archbishop of Tver killed in 1937, which is this folder: display name Thaddeus of Tver, types hieromartyr/archbishop/new-martyr, kept on 18 December in the Greek and Russian calendars, the Greek line reading «Άγιος Θαδδαίος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Τβέρ». A PHOTOGRAPH, not an icon, on the precedent of seraphim-of-vyritsa; a single figure, 556x800, which is over the 560 px long-edge floor but only just. The category's one large file, 4000x3000, is his reliquary casket rather than the saint, and the three remaining portrait photographs are smaller than this one.
